# Crossing-segment native Split control

The one-triangle source and four-triangle cutter are in millimetres. Each cutter triangle intersects the source plane along one of four segments from the deterministic nontrivial strip control documented in `docs/evidence/m2-split-native-facet-traversal-20261029.json`. Cutter endpoints were extended below the source plane and joined to an elevated midpoint; the STL bytes here, rather than the original double-precision segment description, define the actual input.

QUICKSURFACE Pro 8.0.123 imported the source and cutter, with the cutter hidden, and used Edit Scan > Additional tools > Split Mesh > Split with another body or a mesh, Envelope unchecked, then Preview and OK. Its editor reported 14 source triangles, two individual meshes and two holes. `native-preview.jpg` and `native-result-ui.jpg` capture those stages. The visible source was exported to `native-result.stl`. The cutter was exported separately as `native-cutter.stl`; its unordered Float32 facets match the input cutter. The saved `pivot-split.qsf` reopened with source 14 and cutter 4 triangles. The result is a native export comparison; it does not identify the native triangulation algorithm or establish that all cut constraints and safety properties match.

The shared ScanForge operation yields 16 triangles, two indexed components and source area 0.5; the native export also has area 0.5. Nine unordered Float32 facets are common to both. GUI and public MCP matched the ScanForge result on the same STL inputs, with undo/redo, binary reopen and cancellation checks. These observations do not resolve the native facet difference or general M2 acceptance.

Run the focused comparison with `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/m2-native-crossing-pivot.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`. For the compiled browser replay, set `SCANFORGE_SPLIT_CASE=native-pivot-crossing`, `SCANFORGE_SPLIT_INPUT_DIR` to this directory, `SCANFORGE_QA_DIST=dist` and `SCANFORGE_QA_OUT` to a disposable output directory, then run `node tests/scan-split-browser.mjs` under the project resource guard.
